SongDocument.title: SongDocument
SongDocument.description: A user's mastered song project storing track metadata and modified lyrics.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid

title.description: Display title of the song project (1..150 chars)

lyrics.description: Current or modified song lyrics text (0..20000 chars)

lyricsSummary.description: Summary of lyric corrections applied (0..2000 chars)

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

/users/{userId}/songs/{songId}.description: User-owned song documents containing audio metadata and saved lyrics.
